profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Principal Financial Group
profile.summary: Passionate Software Developer with demonstrated experience in insurance industry IT doing front end and back end development. Strong attention to detail, complex problem-solving skills, and a solid work ethic have contributed to exceptional programming skills. Comprehensive experience in maintaining, refactoring, and developing application systems. Positive team player with exceptional communication skills developed from extensive experience in customer service oriented environments. Enthusiastic about continuous learning to build new and improve upon existing knowledge and skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Skills: JSON · SQL DB2 · Java · MDBs · IBM BPM

positions.title: Applications Developer II
positions.description:
Developed and maintained existing computer applications per business area requirements and specifications. Analyzed project information for quality assurance purposes when developing new systems or enhancements. Monitored, identified, and corrected simple to complex system errors. Created and maintained system documentation. Developed and executed comprehensive unit testing and acceptance testing plans. Performed production reviews to ensure data quality and integrity. Collaborated with team members to come up with comprehensive solutions when correcting errors or developing new systems or functionality. Helped train and mentor new developers.  
      
•	Rewrote a complex rating function which had several known errors. Collaborated with system analyst to identify all issues and develop a comprehensive solution. Flow charted the old and new system to help identify root causes and plan the best solution. Saved company revenue and man hours by eliminating the continual errors and providing comprehensive documentation for easier maintainability. New process was later used as the basis for a key functionality to a significant rating enhancement. 
•	Through meticulous efforts in researching and understanding all projects assigned to me, became a subject matter expert in the Personal Auto systems. Utilized this expertise in multiple projects including integration of the legacy rating system into a new platform, among others. 
•	Developed a new batch process for ordering vendor reports which contained data integral to new system enhancements. System continues to be used as it was designed to perform a one-time order for current business as well as do monthly orders for new and renewal business. 
•	Peer programmed with new team members to share knowledge of systems, coding techniques and practices, as well as company coding standards. 
•	Consistently expanded knowledge base and skill set which contributed to consistently exceeding performance goals each year.

positions.title: Individual Investor Specialist III
positions.description:
Assisted individual retirement investors with retirement account questions involving loans, withdrawals, distributions, and investments. Retirement plan expertise included 401k, Defined Contribution, Defined Benefit, ESOP, and Non-Qualified plans.  

•	Licensed to service Principal Managed Account Program and Self-Directed Brokerage Accounts.
•	Acted as Quicken Subject Matter Expert to handle Quicken issues requiring research and/or testing.
•	Mentored new staff by holding mock calls, one on one mentoring sessions, and on the job training.
•	Assisted other specialists by taking "Help Line" calls allowing new staff to utilize veteran knowledge.
•	Participated in focus groups with strived to analyze areas of improvement and develop action plans.

positions.title: Account Specialist
positions.description:
In one of the busiest stores in the district, learned how to effectively manage the need to meet sales quotas while also handling billing issues, providing account maintenance, troubleshooting basic technical issues, and giving general customer service to customers in the retail wireless sales industry.

•	Met daily and monthly quotas based on customer satisfaction, phone/accessory sales, and new activations.
•	Consistently exceeded “five star” customer satisfaction quotas as reflected in satisfaction survey results.

positions.title: Wireless Consultant
positions.description: Provided customer account analysis to increase customer satisfaction by making relevant recommendations to current and potential customers on wireless plans and products. Responsible to open and close store on occasion, create weekly accessories order, perform "Five Star" calls to existing customers, and provide general help and customer service to customers in the wireless industry.
